author: Ryan Williams
who: MIT professor of theoretical computer science
what: An internal OpenAI model has produced a claimed proof that overturns a famous assumption about how hard certain computing puzzles are. Williams, Russell Impagliazzo and Mohan Paturi say they have been asked to organize an open, independent check, and have asked OpenAI to release all its raw data.
quote: An internal model at OpenAI has produced a claimed refutation of ETH!
